mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the closed-world Allowed assignment lets Alloy add arbitrary (Relationship, OperationKind) pairs; injecting ComplianceOfficerRel -> GetRecord forces a state where a compliance officer can read clinical content, directly violating LeastPrivilege and FR_007.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermissionMatrixViolation { ComplianceOfficerRel -> GetRecord in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AuditBijection breaks the surjectivity and injectivity of opAudit; injecting an orphan AuditEntry (with no owning Operation) forces a state where an audit entry exists without a matching access attempt — violating the always-on audit bijection.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditBijectionViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | no op: Operation | op.opAudit = ae }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AuditAttributionCorrect breaks the requirement that entryRole matches the caller's role; injecting a mismatch forces a state where an operation's audit entry records the wrong role, violating attribution correctness.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionViolation { some op: Operation | op.opAudit.entryRole != op.opCaller.role }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_NotesOnlyFromPermittedAppend lets ClinicalNote atoms exist without a backing permitted PostNote operation; injecting an orphan note forces the model to contain a note that was never created by an authorised append, directly violating the append-only invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some n: ClinicalNote | no op: Operation | op.opKind = PostNote and op.opOutcome = Permitted and op.opAudit.entryNote = n }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_PatientAssignedRecordPairing allows a Patient to have no assignedRecord or an extra assignedRecord; injecting a patient without an assignedRecord causes the PatientOwn relationship to become impossible to satisfy, undermining ownership-based access control.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PatientPairingViolation { some u: User | u.role = Patient and no u.assignedRecord }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_OutcomeFromPermissionMatrix severs the tie between the Allowed matrix and opOutcome; injecting a NonCareTeamClinician operation with Permitted outcome on GetRecord forces the model into a state that violates the care-team gating and least-privilege invariants simultaneously.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OutcomeMismatch { some op: Operation | op.opRelationship = NonCareTeamClinician and op.opKind = GetRecord and op.opOutcome = Permitted }
